intro_line: A Gulf capital where pearl-diving past meets modern souks.
intro: Manama rewards visitors with old souks, a lively food scene and easy desert escapes. Pick how long you have and what you enjoy most.
transit_facts: No metro or tram; buses are the main public transport.
Bahrain Public Transport runs routes across the city; route A1 links the airport and Manama every 20 minutes.
Bus single fare is 300 fils paper, or 250 fils with a Go Card; daily cap 600 fils.
Weekly pass BD 3 and 28-day pass BD 12 need a personalised Go Card from a terminal office.
Taxis are metered but pricey; airport rides add BD 2 and hotel pickups add BD 1.
Ride apps like Uber and Careem work in Bahrain; renting a car is cheaper than taxis.

airports.name: Bahrain International Airport
airports.note: Main gateway, in Muharraq about 7 km from the centre.

options.note: Runs every 20 minutes; pay on board or use a Go Card.
Airport surcharge of BD 2 applies; insist on the meter.
Uber and Careem operate; check the pickup point.
Buy a map for BD 0.50-1.00; driving styles vary.
